title: Groq down, task still done
how: Chaos proxy in front of Groq returns HTTP 503 for every request; Bifrost's fallback list names NVIDIA.
result: Success in 5 steps (3.9 s): search, read, patch, run tests, finish. Every step answered by NVIDIA Nemotron; receipt records 5 verified failovers.

title: Gateway stops the run
how: Virtual key with a $0.001/day budget, already spent ($0.0011) by earlier calls on the same key. Penny's own cap set high on purpose.
result: Bifrost refused the first call. Penny stopped with status budget_stopped, layer: gateway, after 0 tokens and 85 ms.

title: Never leaves the machine
how: policy.confidential: true. The local-only key can reach Ollama and nothing else (the gateway refuses cloud models: penny doctor PASS).
result: All 3 calls went to local qwen2.5-coder:3b, none to the cloud. The small CPU model repeated one patch, so Penny's loop guard stopped it: the task was not solved locally (needs a 7B+ model).
